questions.why: Між *as … as* стоїть звичайна форма прикметника: *as tall as*. *taller* — для порівняння з *than*.
Заперечне порівняння — *not as … as*: *He isn't as strong as me.*
Між *as … as* — звичайна форма: *as fast as*.

options: She is as tall than me.
She is as tall as me.
She is as taller as me.
She is same tall as me.
questions.why: Конструкція — *as … as*: *as tall as me*. *as … than* — помилка змішування.

questions.q: The negative of 'as tall as' is:
questions.why: Заперечення — *not as tall as*.
Між двома *as* — звичайна форма прикметника, без *-er* і *more*.

questions.q: This bag is as ___ as that one. (heavy)
questions.why: Звичайна форма: *as heavy as*.

answer: He is as strong as me
questions.why: *as* + прикметник + *as*.

questions.q: My car is not as ___ as yours.
questions.why: *not as expensive as* — звичайна форма між *as … as*.

questions.q: She runs as ___ as her brother.
questions.why: *as fast as* — тут *fast* прислівник, теж у звичайній формі.

questions.q: This room is twice as ___ as that one.
questions.why: *twice as big as* — удвічі більший.

questions.q: I don't have as ___ free time as you.
questions.why: *time* — нелічильне, тому *as much free time as*.

questions.q: Your phone is the same ___ mine.
questions.why: *the same as* — «такий самий, як». *the same like* — помилка.

questions.q: He isn't as ___ as he looks.
questions.why: Звичайна форма: *as old as he looks*.

questions.q: There aren't as ___ people as yesterday.
questions.why: *people* — лічильне, тому *as many people as*.
*as soon as possible* — сталий вираз «якнайшвидше».
У розмові після *as* — об'єктний займенник *me*. Формальніше — *as clever as I am*.

answer: The bus is not as fast as the train
questions.why: *not as fast as*.
questions.hint: Автобус не такий швидкий, як потяг.

answer: She is as tall as her mother
questions.why: *as tall as her mother*.
questions.hint: Вона така ж висока, як її мама.

answer: This book is twice as long as that one
questions.why: *twice as long as*.
questions.hint: Ця книжка вдвічі довша за ту.

questions.q: This exam wasn't ___ hard as I expected.
questions.why: *not nearly as … as* — «зовсім не такий, як».
*as soon as possible* — *possible*, прикметник, а не прислівник.

questions.q: She's just ___ talented as her brother.
questions.why: *just as … as* — «так само, як».
